Bin events into a rink grid

Source: R/geom_rink_bin.R
rink_bin.Rd

Aggregates events into the square grid that geom_rink_bin() draws: one row per occupied cell (per group) with the event count and the mean value. Use it to derive your own cell values (differences between teams, shrinkage, rates per 60, ...) and plot them with geom_rink_bin(precomputed = TRUE).

Usage

rink_bin(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  value = NULL,
  binwidth = 2.5,
  by = NULL,
  dimensions = IIHF,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of events.

x, y

Coordinate columns (unquoted).

value

Column to average within each cell (unquoted). Omit for counts only (value is then NA).

binwidth

Cell size, in rink units.

by

Columns to group by in addition to the cell, e.g. team or c(team, period) (unquoted, tidyselect).

dimensions, xlim, ylim

Binning bounds, as in geom_rink_bin().

Value

A tibble with the by columns, x and y (cell centres), n (event count) and value (mean of value, ignoring NAs).

See also

geom_rink_bin()

Examples

cells <- rink_bin(shots, x, y, value = xg, binwidth = 2, by = team)
head(cells)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   team         x     y     n  value
#>   <chr>    <dbl> <dbl> <int>  <dbl>
#> 1 Lakeside    39     1     1 0.0084
#> 2 Lakeside    39     5     1 0.0168
#> 3 Lakeside    39     7     2 0.0226
#> 4 Lakeside    39     9     1 0.0256
#> 5 Lakeside    39    11     3 0.0312
#> 6 Lakeside    39    13     3 0.0330

# Difference between the two teams, cell by cell
library(ggplot2)
wide <- merge(cells[cells$team == "Lakeside", ], cells[cells$team == "Northfield", ],
              by = c("x", "y"), suffixes = c("_a", "_b"))
wide$value <- wide$value_a - wide$value_b
wide$n <- wide$n_a + wide$n_b

ggplot(wide, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate_rink(zones = "oz", orientation = "vertical") +
  geom_rink_bin(precomputed = TRUE, style = "fill", diverging = TRUE, binwidth = 2)
